state.billing_rules: Non-cached input tokens cost USD 2 per 1,000,000 tokens. Cached input tokens cost USD 0.50 per 1,000,000 tokens. The cached tokens are included in the total input-token count; do not bill them again at the non-cached rate. All amounts are in USD. Charges are prorated per token, with no minimum charge, tax, or monetary rounding. Only input tokens are billable; there are no output-token or other charges.
